models.notes: The app serves on the VM's 127.0.0.1:8790 only. Connect with `gcloud compute tpus tpu-vm ssh hy-nomas --zone=asia-northeast1-b -- -L 8790:127.0.0.1:8790` (your chip's name and zone) and open http://127.0.0.1:8790 on your own machine. The start times below are with the weights downloaded and still in the VM's memory; the first start after the VM restarts reads them from disk again and takes longer.
